author: TEDx Talks
description:
With AI and the internet at our fingertips, learning should be easier than ever. But it isn't. That's because learning doesn't start with information outside our heads—it starts within. Cognitive scientist Tania Lombrozo, author of Why We Ask Why: The Science of Explanation and the Human Drive to Understand, reveals how asking the right questions and transforming the information we already have can make us better learners in an age of information overload.

Tania is a professor of psychology at Princeton University, where she also directs the Program in Cognitive Science and co-leads the Natural and Artificial Minds initiative. Bridging cognitive science and philosophy, her research explores how we explain, understand, and reason. She has received numerous early-career awards, including the Stanton Prize, the Spence Award, an NSF CAREER award, and a James S. McDonnell Foundation Scholar Award in Understanding Human Cognition. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED confere
title: How you can learn in a world of information overload | Tania Lombrozo | TEDxNewEngland

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A celebrated calligrapher, QEST alumnus, and finalist for England Maker of the Year 2025. His work has been exhibited nationally and internationally, combining artistry, craftsmanship, and reflection. Today, he shares the life lessons he has learned through the ancient art of calligraphy. 
 Razwan Ul-Haq is an internationally recognised Arabic calligrapher, artist, author, and QEST Scholar whose work explores the relationship between words, meaning, spirituality, and visual art. Inspired from childhood by his uncle, the renowned calligrapher Maulvi Fazal Azeem, Razwan has spent decades mastering and reimagining the classical traditions of Arabic and Persian calligraphy through a contemporary lens.

His work has been featured by the BBC, Channel 4, The Times, and international media, with commissions ranging from Leeds City Art Gallery to large-scale public installations for the Tour de France and Bradford 2025. Blending traditional bamboo pens and hand-mixed inks with influences from
title: What calligraphy has taught me about life  | Razwan Ul-Haq | TEDxHeaton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A multi-award-winning business coach, consultant, five-time author, martial arts leader, and founder of Black Belt Mindset Coaching and Consulting, our next speaker has dedicated his life to helping people and organisations grow. Drawing on lessons from martial arts and personal development, he explores how curiosity and a beginner's mindset can unlock lifelong learning. 
 Raj Soren is an award-winning coach, speaker, author, and leadership consultant with over 35 years’ experience across the pharmaceutical, biotech, and corporate training sectors. Drawing on decades of leadership experience and lifelong martial arts practice, Raj has developed a powerful approach to personal growth and resilience known as the “Black Belt Mindset.”

Passionate about mental wellbeing, leadership, and human potential, Raj has coached leaders, entrepreneurs, NHS organisations, charities, and community groups to overcome stress, burnout, and self-doubt while building confidence, discipline, and purpose. H
title: A black belt mindset for lifelong learning | Raj Soren | TEDxHeaton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Farhana Bham, also known as Farhana Pandor, is a mother, accountant, poet, and lifelong learner. Her personal journey through leadership, creativity, family life, and self-discovery has shaped her belief that success isn't something we arrive at—it's something we continuously become. 
 Farhana Bham is a financial controller, licensed accountant, and founder of Pan Accounts, with over nine years’ experience helping businesses and organisations make sense of their numbers, strategy, and decision-making. Passionate about humanising finance, she brings a people-centred approach to leadership, financial literacy, and sustainable growth.

Alongside her professional work, Farhana—also known creatively as Farhana Pandor—is a British poet whose writing explores identity, transformation, and the architecture of character. Her debut poetry collection, Flames from the Shadows, reflects her passion for storytelling, reflection, and personal growth.

She also serves as a financial consultant for Af
title: Who decides when you're successful?  | Farhana Bham | TEDxHeaton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What can you do when you start feeling that your life no longer fits you? 
Amy Schutte is a keynote speaker, award-winning writer, and founder of Hudson & Co, and she believes that the stories we tell ourselves shape what we think is possible. A former journalist, Amy works at the intersection of communication, identity, and transformation. Over the last decade, she has advised founders, executive teams, startups, and global brands on multimillion-dollar launches, strategic messaging, and high-stakes communication across the United States, Europe, and Asia. She is the host of the Business Origin Stories podcast and the author of the forthcoming book The Kármán Effect. Amy imagines a world where everyone feels confident to stop painting inside the lines–and starts crossing them. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx.
 Amy Schutte is a former journalist, keynote speaker
title: What to do when your life stops fitting | Amy Schutte | TEDxCambridge University

author: TEDx Talks
description: Every generation inherits a world shaped by those who came before it, but some choose to do more than simply adapt. They choose to create. This talk explores how a new generation is transforming ideas into action, challenges into opportunities and personal expression into collective impact. It is an invitation to stop waiting for permission, take ownership of our potential and actively build the future we want to see. Moroccan Rapper from Rabat Morocco. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Generation that chose to CREATE | Vargas  | TEDxUM5

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In his talk, The Amplified Individual, Luis discusses how artificial intelligence can widen opportunity by giving people greater access to the support, insight and tools that were once limited to those with traditional qualifications, networks or financial backing. Drawing on his own journey from a career-ending rugby injury to building businesses without formal credentials, he explores the difference between capability and qualifications, and how AI can help individuals test ideas, avoid costly mistakes and think more clearly. Ultimately, Luis argues that AI is not replacing human intelligence but amplifying it, while vision, judgement, resilience and lived experience remain distinctly human. Luis Evitt is a British entrepreneur, marketing consultant, and founder of several ventures including Social90, Agency Architecture, and nowhey. 

A former professional rugby player, Luis’s sporting career was cut short by injury at eighteen, a turning point that led him into the world of online
title: The Amplified Individual | Luis Evitt | TEDxWolverhampton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Democracy is never a permanent guarantee; it is a fragile system that can slide into fascism when citizens stop actively defending it. The shift toward authoritarianism typically begins when the public becomes complacent—choosing to remain ignorant of political realities, staying silent in the face of injustice, and giving in to blind obedience. Because we are all ultimately accountable for the choice between freedom and tyranny, preventing the rise of fascism requires an active refusal to look away. It demands a well-informed electorate that understands the mechanisms of oppression and fiercely protects its constitutional rights through open dialogue and critical thinking. Professor, Department of International Business
University of Dhaka This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: How Silence Fuels Fascism | Dr. Chowdhury Saima Ferdous | TEDxKhulna University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In her thought provoking talk, Sienna, explores the idea of the “safety theatre”: systems, policies and behaviours that create the appearance or feeling of safety without tackling the root causes of danger. Drawing on the everyday experience of a young person navigating public spaces and the realities of youth violence, it challenges how responsibility is often placed on individuals to adapt, avoid and protect themselves. Sienna calls for us to question performative solutions, embrace uncomfortable conversations and build long-term systems that prevent harm rather than simply reassure us that something is being done. Sienna Ahir is a 17-year-old youth activist, public speaker, and founder of Daggers Down, a youth-led anti-knife crime campaign reshaping conversations around violence in the West Midlands.

As the Member of Youth Parliament for Wolverhampton, she has delivered speeches in the House of Commons on national issues from employment inequality to youth safety, championing the
title: Inside the safety theatre - When safety becomes risk | Sienna Ahir | TEDxWolverhampton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A traditional dance performance inspired by the cultural heritage of Arta, bringing local dances, customs and collective memories to life. Through music, movement and traditional costumes, the performance highlights the connection between past and present and the role of dance in preserving local identity across generations. The Athletic and Cultural Group of Students of Arta (A.P.O.F.A.) is a student association created to bring young people together through collaboration, creativity and collective expression. Today, the group is primarily active through its traditional dance ensemble, preserving Greek cultural heritage while creating a welcoming space for connection, participation and artistic expression within the student community.

Guided by the values of culture, teamwork and inclusion, A.P.O.F.A. seeks to create shared experiences that strengthen relationships among students. At the same time, it remains open to new ideas, collaborations and initiatives that encourage active pa
title: In the Footsteps of Arta – Roots, Dances and Memory | APOFA - | TEDxArta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
NASA's astronaut selection has always looked for "the Right Stuff": composure under pressure, tolerance for risk, the ability to follow orders when things go wrong. But missions to Mars demand a different set of qualities: resourcefulness, resilience and autonomy. Rather than default to who we have always pictured as an astronaut, this talk looks at what the research shows about who leads with those qualities, and makes the case for why sending women to Mars first is the smart move.

Caroline lived this question first-hand as an analogue astronaut at LunAres Research Station in Poland, part of a crew simulating life on the lunar surface. 

Whether you work in space, tech or any field navigating uncertainty and high stakes, this talk will change how you think about who gets chosen to lead. Ad astra.

Website: https://expansum.space/ 
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/caroline-clark-psychologist/ 
Newsletter, Liftoff with Caroline: https://liftoff.carolineclark.space/ Caroline Clark
title: Mars Exploration: Why Sending Women First is the Smart Move | Caroline Clark | TEDxWolverhampton

author: TEDx Talks
description: Every day, we spend our attention before we know where it has gone. Fields of design have long studied how chairs support backs and handles fit hands. But modern life asks us to carry a newer kind of strain: the urgency of notifications, the friction of interactions, and the complexity of systems that shape our daily experience. Designer Shuya Gong explores emotional ergonomics as a way of easing this hidden labor — and asks how the world around us, both physical and digital, might change what we notice, what we care about, what we feel, and who we become Shuya Gong is a designer and strategist whose work explores how emerging technologies reshape human behavior, relationships, and the systems around us. She is on the faculty of Harvard University’s Master in Design Engineering program and previously served as the Design Innovation Fellow at the Technology & Entrepreneurship Center at Harvard. Her current research focuses on emotional ergonomics: the hidden and cumulative labor impose
title: Emotional Ergonomics: The Cost of Attention | Shuya Gong | TEDxUM5

author: TEDx Talks
description: Les transformations les plus profondes sont rarement immédiates ou spectaculaires. Elles se construisent silencieusement, à travers des efforts répétés, des choix quotidiens et des progrès parfois difficiles à percevoir. Cette intervention nous invite à repenser notre rapport au temps, à la patience et au changement, en montrant pourquoi ce qui semble immobile aujourd’hui peut devenir une véritable transformation demain. Nawal Sfendla Alpiniste de Haute Altitude This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: La transformation :pourquoi les plus grands changements prennent du temps | Nawal Sfendla | TEDxUM5

author: TEDx Talks
description: Where does freedom of speech end, and legal responsibility begin? This talk examines freedom of expression through a legal lens, exploring how laws seek to protect the right to speak freely while setting boundaries to safeguard individuals and society. It invites us to consider the delicate balance between liberty, responsibility and the rights of others. Abdellah El Alaoui Salami holds a PhD in Law and is an attorney at the Casablanca Bar Association and a Data Protection Officer. He previously served as Secretary-General of the Moroccan Youth Government and Vice-President of the Moroccan Association of Data Protection Officers. He is currently Vice-President of the Moroccan Forum for Freedom of Belief and Thought and an honorary member of the National Commission for Taxation and Public Accounting at Morocco’s Ministry of Economy and Finance. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www
title: Freedom of speech from a Legal Perspective | Abdellah Salami El Alaoui | TEDxUM5

author: TEDx Talks
description:
演講摘要：剪紙藝術家楊士毅出身清貧，童年曾有長達十年寄人籬下的生活。然而，艱困的成長經歷並未使他失去對世界的溫柔，反而淬鍊出堅韌、善良且細膩的生命底色，使他始終保有感受美好的能力，並從日常的人事物中發現值得珍惜的片刻。

為了這場演講，楊士毅花費一個多月準備內容。他不只是整理自己的生命經驗，更不斷站在觀眾的角度思考，希望理解聽眾真正需要接收的訊息。這份對他人的敏銳感受力，也成為他作品與分享能觸動人心的重要原因。

在這場演講中，他提出：「感受力就像構成萬物的原子。」看似微小，卻是支撐生命豐盛與創造力的根本。當一個人保有足夠的感受力，便能發展出更深刻的共情能力，以及持續創造的靈感。而初心，也如同一顆微小的原子，只要持續守護與累積，終將成為照亮生命的力量。

在資訊快速流動、知識不斷更新的時代，人們容易陷入追逐新知的焦慮。楊士毅認為，比起不斷向外探索，更重要的是向內理解自己，重新培養感受世界的能力。

多年來，他保持書寫日記的習慣，累積超過五、六十本手寫日記。透過長期的自我對話，他磨練對生命的敏銳度，也讓自己持續保持好奇與創造力。

這份深厚的感受力，成為他創作的重要養分。

從牛年花園裝置中向默默付出的人致敬，將陪伴與奉獻比喻為天使；到鼠年燈節作品傳遞「初心即未來」的信念，提醒人們不必過度焦慮未知，只需守護內心的純粹；與蘋果公司的合作中重新詮釋人與人之間的善意連結；以及臺南鹽田地景創作中，以鹽田沉澱象徵人生歷程，致敬每一位在逆境中堅持前行的人。

楊士毅始終相信，美好並不在遙遠的未來，而存在於每一個當下。

當我們重新喚醒與生俱來的感受力，用心看見生命中的細節與溫度，每個人都能創造屬於自己的獨特風景。

TEDxXinyi (Taipei, Taiwan)

author: TEDx Talks
description: Questo talk, ci porterà con nel cuore dei tribunali per l’immigrazione degli Stati Uniti, al fianco delle famiglie che ci arrivano dopo mesi, anni, di spostamenti di Stato in Stato con la speranza di una vita migliore. E che si trovano invece a fronteggiare nuovi e inaspettati pericoli. Le vite di uomini, donne e bambini, profondamente condizionate dall’incontro con la violenza, lo sfruttamento e la corruzione, sono impresse nelle fotografie che Nicolò ha scattato per non lasciare al tempo il potere di cancellare le tracce di queste vite. Nicolò Filippo Rosso (1985) è un fotografo concentrato su temi sociali, ambientali e umanitari tra Americhe, Medio Oriente e Africa. Dal 2018 documenta le migrazioni nel continente americano. Vincitore di The Alexia e del W. Eugene Smith Fund. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: In nome della Legge | Nicolò Filippo Rosso | TEDxCuneo

author: TEDx Talks
description: In a time of growing misinformation, fascistic rhetoric, and pressure to adopt AI, be brave enough to question what you’re being told, to navigate media as though everything is political. Jessica discusses the necessity of English literature, a critical lens, and general agency and curiosity as not only a necessity but an act of rebellion in a time of anti-intellectualism. Join her as she walks through the process of identifying and understanding political ideology in the most unexpected places–– and how a cookbook changed her life. Jessica Mancini is a Canadian University of Oxford graduate student studying English literature; she specializes in the Romantic Period, book history, and non-literary women’s print focusing on socio-political criticism, ideology, and historicization. She has presented and published original research at conferences in Canada, the U.S., and the UK, most notably at Harvard University, the University of Toronto, and the British Association for American Studie
title: A Pinch of Politics from Past to Present   | Jessica Mancini | TEDxOxford

author: TEDx Talks
description: E se a generosidade fosse uma das maiores forças de transformação da sociedade? Nesta palestra, Antonia Monteiro de Barros, Tatiana Monteiro de Barros e Marcella Monteiro de Barros compartilham como o Movimento União BR mobiliza pessoas, organizações e comunidades para responder a desafios humanitários. Uma reflexão sobre o poder da colaboração, da empatia e da ação coletiva para construir um futuro melhor. Antonia Monteiro de Barros, Tatiana Monteiro de Barros e Marcella Monteiro de Barros são fundadoras do Movimento União BR, a maior iniciativa humanitária da América Latina especializada em resposta a desastres climáticos. Desde 2020, o movimento já apoiou mais de 34 milhões de pessoas e atuou em parceria com mais de 3 mil organizações sociais. Com trajetórias que unem liderança, empreendedorismo, comunicação, gestão, direito e impacto social, elas transformaram a solidariedade em uma rede capaz de mobilizar milhares de voluntários, empresas e instituições em todo o Brasil. Pelo tra
title: Como a Generosidade Molda o Futuro | Antonia, Tatiana e Marcella Monteiro de Barros | TEDxCarandá

author: TEDx Talks
description:
AI can optimise almost anything it can measure. Dr Zohar Bronfman argues that this is exactly why it will never be able to tell us what is worth wanting. Every intelligent system, human or artificial, climbs towards something it values, but AI can only climb towards what is observable, measurable or explicitly assumed. Human value has a second dimension, made of love, aesthetics, fun and the example we want to set, and none of it reduces to a variable. As AI collapses the time we spend on execution, the scarce skill becomes the ability to define and refine our own goals, sharpened by creativity that adds new peaks to our value space and by ethics that brings the blurred parts of it into focus. The smarter AI gets, the more human we must become.

Dr Zohar Bronfman spent his adult life studying intelligence, moving between research into how minds and machines learn to predict, and the practical business of building systems that turn prediction into action for organisations around the wo
title: What AI could never do for us  | Dr Zohar Bronfman | TEDxCambridge University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We’re often taught to focus on being seen, but what if the real power lies in seeing others? Drawing from a lifetime of experiences—from the front door of a Harlem restaurant to community initiatives, boardrooms, and cultural stages—Tren’ness Woods-Black explores how the simple act of truly seeing people creates belonging, builds trust, and strengthens communities. Through a series of personal stories, she reveals how some of the most meaningful opportunities and lasting legacies emerge when we make people feel that they belong. Tren’ness Woods-Black is a visionary strategist, culture-preneur, and global ambassador of hospitality, known as “The Queen of Hospitality” for transforming cultural authenticity into business and community impact. A third-generation leader and granddaughter of legendary restaurateur Sylvia Woods of Sylvia’s Restaurant, she combines family legacy with innovative brand strategy, experiential marketing, and cultural storytelling.

As President and Chief Strategi
title: You Belong at the Door | Tren’ness Woods-Black | TEDxHarlem

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Alcune radici sono invisibili: si nascondono sotto la superficie del mare. In questo talk, Gianni Jacucci ci conduce alla scoperta dei microorganismi marini, esseri minuscoli che producono una parte fondamentale dell’ossigeno che respiriamo e il cui movimento può essere studiato e guidato tramite la luce. Attraverso la fisica, questo racconto mostra come comprendere il comportamento delle microalghe possa aprire nuove possibilità, dalla produzione sostenibile alla realizzazione di microrobot biologici. Un viaggio nella scienza, che ci ricorda come guardare lontano non significhi dimenticare da dove veniamo: perché le radici profonde non gelano. Gianni Jacucci è un fisico calabrese e ricercatore Tenure Track che, dopo esperienze di studio e lavoro presso istituzioni di eccellenza internazionale — tra cui l'Università di Cambridge e l'École Normale Supérieure di Parigi — ha scelto consapevolmente di tornare in Calabria. 
Oggi guida un gruppo di ricerca presso l'Università della Calabria
title: Le radici nascoste | Gianni Jacucci | TEDxAmantea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Perché, davanti all'incertezza, sentiamo il bisogno di avere subito una risposta? E se il cambiamento più profondo iniziasse proprio nel momento in cui smettiamo di riempire ogni vuoto con una soluzione? In questo talk, Giuseppe Petrosino esplora il valore della pausa, della presenza e della capacità di restare nelle domande prima di cercare le risposte.
Attraverso esperienze personali e professionali, riflette su come persone, team e organizzazioni affrontino i momenti di trasformazione, mostrando che il vero cambiamento non nasce dall'accelerare o dal controllare tutto, ma dal creare lo spazio necessario perché possa emergere qualcosa di nuovo. Un invito a riscoprire il coraggio di sostare nell'incertezza come primo passo verso un cambiamento autentico. Giuseppe Petrosino è Founder di Paradeigma Consulting e advisor strategico nel settore Life Sciences. Da oltre vent'anni affianca aziende farmaceutiche, organizzazioni sanitarie e board executive che operano in contesti caratterizzat
title: Sostare sulla soglia | Giuseppe Petrosino | TEDxAmantea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Il mondo inizia davvero quando si parte? O può cominciare proprio nel luogo da cui siamo partiti? In questo talk, Aida Bruni racconta come un percorso tra Berlino, Madrid e Amantea le abbia insegnato che non bisogna scegliere tra le proprie radici e l'apertura al mondo.
Attraverso la sua esperienza personale e professionale, mostra come i luoghi possano trasformarsi quando diventano spazi di incontro, dialogo e contaminazione culturale. Un invito a ripensare il significato del partire e del tornare, scoprendo che il cambiamento nasce quando mondi diversi si incontrano e costruiscono qualcosa di nuovo. Aida Bruni è direttrice del The Convent Centre of Language & Art APS, esperta di progettazione europea e Project Manager specializzata nei programmi Erasmus+. Dopo un percorso internazionale tra Madrid, Berlino e Malta, ha scelto di tornare ad Amantea per trasformare uno storico convento in un luogo di incontro tra culture, giovani e idee provenienti da tutta Europa.
Da anni si occupa di
title: Dove inizia il mondo | Aida Bruni | TEDxAmantea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Il management è davvero solo procedure, numeri e riunioni? O è qualcosa che sperimentiamo ogni giorno, molto più vicino alla nostra vita di quanto immaginiamo? In questo talk, Valeria Tozzi ribalta il significato di una delle parole più fraintese del mondo del lavoro, mostrando come il management sia, prima di tutto, una pratica fatta di relazioni, fiducia e collaborazione.
Attraverso esperienze personali e professionali, accompagna il pubblico in una riflessione su ciò che rende possibile trasformare decisioni, idee e progetti in azioni concrete. Un intervento che invita a guardare oltre gli stereotipi, riscoprendo il management come una grammatica invisibile che permette alle persone di costruire insieme il cambiamento. Valeria Tozzi è Associate Professor of Practice presso la Government, Health and Not for Profit Division di SDA Bocconi School of Management. Dal 2014 al 2023 ha diretto il Master MIMS (Master in Management Sanitario) e oggi è Direttrice dell'EMMAS (Executive Master
title: Di cosa parliamo quando parliamo di management? | Valeria Tozzi | TEDxAmantea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In his TEDx talk, Simon invites audiences to look beneath the surface of addiction, anxiety, and the patterns that keep us disconnected from ourselves and one another. Blending professional insight with lived experience, he challenges the idea that our struggles are something to hide or judge, and instead offers a more compassionate way to understand them: with curiosity.
This is a talk for anyone who has ever felt stuck in old behaviours, overwhelmed by emotion, or unsure why they keep repeating the same relationship dynamics. Simon speaks with honesty and warmth about what it means to become more conscious of our inner world, and how small shifts in awareness can open the door to healing, healthier connection, and real change.
By the end, viewers are left with a powerful reminder: we are not broken beyond repair, and we do not have to face our struggles alone. Simon’s message is both deeply human and quietly hopeful, encouraging people to replace shame with understanding, judgment w
title: From rock bottom to real connection | Simon Wainman | TEDxRishworth Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
An internationally recognised filmmaker and producer from Bradford (U.K) whose work has taken him across the globe. Collaborating with musicians, charities, NGOs, and organisations worldwide, he has built a career around one central belief—that powerful stories matter more than transactions, marketing, or business plans. 
 Pishdaad Modaressi is a Bradford-based filmmaker and creative producer whose work explores storytelling, identity, culture, and the human experience through cinema and visual media. With over a decade of experience creating documentaries, music videos, and creative productions across the UK and internationally, his work is driven by a passion for meaningful stories that leave a lasting impact.

Inspired by a family legacy of filmmaking that began with his father in Iran, Pishdaad uses film as a tool for connection, reflection, and social change. His projects have explored themes including mental health, migration, resilience, and community, combining cinematic creat
title: Story over business in filmmaking | Pishdaad Modaressi | TEDxHeaton

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Bien au-delà de la cuisine, la gastronomie moléculaire et physique est une discipline scientifique qui explore les phénomènes à l'œuvre lors des transformations des aliments. À travers sa démonstration expérimentale, Hervé This montre comment la science permet de comprendre, d'expliquer et de réinventer notre manière d'aborder l'alimentation. En repoussant les frontières entre recherche fondamentale et innovation, il nous invite à voir la connaissance scientifique comme un levier essentiel pour imaginer et (p)réparer les pratiques alimentaires de demain.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
다른 사람의 시선에 휘둘리지 않고 마음속 꿈을 믿으며 나아갈 때 비로소 자신의 삶이 꽃피기 시작한다. 얼마나 오래 걸리더라도 꿈이 빛을 발하는 순간은 반드시 찾아온다. 인하대학교 학사

서울대학교 음악대학 기악과 수석입학, 수석졸업 서울대학교 음악대학 전체수석 석사&박사 학위 취득 미국 Cleveland Institute of Music, Indiana University에서 Artist Diploma 취득 KBS 클래식 라디오 출연 및 연주 유튜브 채널 또모 의 누적 조회수 6000만회 이상 영상 출연, 정소윤의 음악노트 채널 운영중 (현) 건국대학교 음악교육과 겸임교수, 예원학교, 서울예고, 선화예중고 출강

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 환승, 돌고 돌아 찾아가는 꿈 | So Yoon Jung | TEDxKHU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Face aux défis environnementaux et humains de notre époque, Claire Pétreault nous invite à repenser notre engagement à travers le prisme des saisons. En s'inspirant des rythmes naturels, elle montre qu'agir durablement ne consiste pas à être constamment dans l'action, mais à alterner les temps d'élan, de réflexion, de repos et de renouveau. Une intervention qui nous rappelle que respecter ces cycles est essentiel pour préserver notre énergie et continuer à (p)réparer demain.
 Formation
*   Master en Communication, Media et IndustriesCréatrices à Sciences Po
*   Master en management de l'Innovation Numérique à Télécom Paris

Fondatrice du média "Les Pépites Vertes": Média et
Communauté pour équiper les jeunes talents de la transition écologique. 
Sa mission : motiver la nouvelle génération à bosser pour la transition écologique. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Respecter les saisons pour garder la flamme de l'engagement | Claire Pétreault | TEDxAgroParisTech

description:
Véritables régulateurs de notre planète, les océans jouent un rôle essentiel dans l’équilibre du climat, la biodiversité et le fonctionnement des écosystèmes. Clarisse Cier nous invite à redécouvrir ces piliers invisibles du vivant et à comprendre les menaces qui pèsent aujourd’hui sur eux. Une intervention qui met en lumière l’importance de préserver les océans pour construire un avenir plus durable et rétablir notre lien avec le monde marin.
